# A little red crab that scuttles along the sand: a squat body, two claws, six legs, stalk eyes.
# Faces -Y; origin on the sand under its body.
new
material new Shell --base-color 0.8314 0.1176 0.2353 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.9804 1.0000 1.0000 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --name Body --segments 8 --rings 4 --radius 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.32 0.22 0.15
apply --scale
set location 0 0 0.2
apply --location
material assign Shell
add mesh ico-sphere --name ClawL --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.12 --location -0.38 -0.22 0.22
material assign Shell
add mesh cylinder --name StalkL --vertices 4 --radius 0.03 --depth 0.16 --location -0.1 -0.12 0.36
material assign Shell
add mesh ico-sphere --name EyeL --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.06 --location -0.1 -0.13 0.45
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name LegL0 --size 1 --location -0.38 -0.08 0.08
scale 0.22 0.05 0.05
apply --scale
set rotation 0 30 0
material assign Shell
add mesh cube --name LegL1 --size 1 --location -0.38 0.04 0.08
scale 0.22 0.05 0.05
apply --scale
set rotation 0 30 0
material assign Shell
add mesh cube --name LegL2 --size 1 --location -0.38 0.16 0.08
scale 0.22 0.05 0.05
apply --scale
set rotation 0 30 0
material assign Shell
add mesh ico-sphere --name ClawR --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.12 --location 0.38 -0.22 0.22
material assign Shell
add mesh cylinder --name StalkR --vertices 4 --radius 0.03 --depth 0.16 --location 0.1 -0.12 0.36
material assign Shell
add mesh ico-sphere --name EyeR --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.06 --location 0.1 -0.13 0.45
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name LegR0 --size 1 --location 0.38 -0.08 0.08
scale 0.22 0.05 0.05
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -30 0
material assign Shell
add mesh cube --name LegR1 --size 1 --location 0.38 0.04 0.08
scale 0.22 0.05 0.05
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -30 0
material assign Shell
add mesh cube --name LegR2 --size 1 --location 0.38 0.16 0.08
scale 0.22 0.05 0.05
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -30 0
material assign Shell
select all
shade flat
export crab.glb
